meta.objective: Add parameter validation to plugin to prevent crashes from invalid values

tasks.title: Add range validation for all parameter setters
tasks.description: Implement validation logic in PluginProcessor to ensure all parameter values are within valid ranges before applying them. This prevents crashes or undefined behavior from out-of-range values that might come from corrupted presets or automation data.
acceptance_criteria: All parameters clamp values to defined min/max ranges
Invalid values are logged with DBG() for debugging
No crashes occur with extreme or invalid parameter values
Unit tests verify validation for all parameters
tasks.notes: Use juce::NormalisableRange::snapToLegalValue() for consistent validation. Add tests with intentionally invalid values.

tasks.title: Add null pointer checks in parameter access
tasks.description: Add null pointer checks before dereferencing parameters retrieved from AudioProcessorValueTreeState. This prevents crashes when accessing parameters that may not exist in older preset versions.
acceptance_criteria: All parameter access includes null check
Graceful fallback to default values on null
Crash reports show zero null pointer dereferences
Code review confirms all getRawParameterValue() calls are checked
tasks.notes: Focus on processBlock() and setStateInformation() methods. Use smart pattern like auto* param = apvts.getRawParameterValue('id'); if (param != nullptr) { use(*param); }

tasks.title: Add parameter value sanitization in setStateInformation
tasks.description: Sanitize and validate parameter values when loading presets in setStateInformation(). Check for NaN, infinity, and out-of-range values before applying to parameters.
acceptance_criteria: Preset loading handles NaN and infinity values safely
Out-of-range values are clamped to valid range
User receives warning (once) if preset has invalid data
Plugin uses default values for invalid parameters
Test suite includes fuzzing with random preset data
tasks.notes: Use std::isfinite() to check for NaN/infinity. Consider adding preset version check for future compatibility.

tasks.title: Update documentation with parameter validation approach
tasks.description: Document the parameter validation strategy in REFERENCE.md and add usage examples to DEVELOPMENT.md. Include guidelines for developers adding new parameters.
acceptance_criteria: DEVELOPMENT.md includes example of adding validated parameter
Documentation shows how to test parameter validation
Best practices section added for parameter safety
tasks.notes: Include code snippets showing proper validation patterns. Reference JUCE best practices documentation.
